If you need a resource that requires a Workshop Lv. 3, you will need to upgrade your workshop to level 3. To do that, you will first need to check if you have completed all the necessary base operations and requirements for upgrading your workshop.

Once you have met the requirements, you can go to the building menu and select the workshop. From there, you should see the option to upgrade to level 3. Selecting this option will take you to the upgrade screen, where you can see the cost and required materials to upgrade your workshop. Once you have gathered all the materials, you can proceed with the upgrade, and your workshop will be upgraded to Lv. 3.

To unlock the workshop, you need to build the reception room, which is the central hub of your base. Once you have built the reception room, you will unlock the workshop building option in your "Base" menu.

To build the workshop, click on the "Base" button, and then scroll down to find the "Workshop" option. Click on the "Workshop" button, and you will see a blue print of the workshop building on your base layout. You can drag and drop the workshop blue print to a free spot on your base layout and then confirm the placement.

Once the workshop is placed, you will need to wait for a certain amount of time for it to be constructed. After the construction is complete, you can click on the workshop to access its functions, such as building and upgrading other facilities in your base, trading for resources, and crafting items.
